data.one_liner: A widget-based custom info window for the google_maps_flutter package.
data.what_it_does: It provides a custom info window implementation for Google Maps in Flutter using standard widgets. This allows developers to display customized UI elements over map markers instead of the default platform info windows.
use_when: You need custom layouts or styling inside a Google Maps info window
You are already using the google_maps_flutter package
avoid_when: You are using a map provider other than google_maps_flutter
You do not need custom info windows and can rely on default markers
strengths: Enables fully widget-based custom info windows on Google Maps
